A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
tailored communications are most effective when they are designed to fit the information-processing style of the target audience.
tailored messages are more persuasive than nontailored messages, and that tailoring to the NFC is a viable strategy.
tailoring messages to an individual's need for cognition may increase the likelihood that the individual will engage in a desired health behavior, such as mammography.
The main takeaway from our work is that
tailoring messages to individuals' NFC can increase the effectiveness of health communication campaigns.
tailoring health communication to an individual's need for cognition is one way to improve the effectiveness of these messages.
